war_summary: War 139 is on day 113 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map remains heavily consolidated in rear areas — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many others; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail, Weathered Expanse — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Since the prior snapshot (~3h ago), the biggest change is that Olavis Wake has collapsed from its extreme surge (~800/hr casualties) to near-quiet, with the last event ~2.5h old; it appears the Ilmari Bridge fight has resolved for the Colonials. Endless Shore remains the largest battle: a 5-5 split with ~49 events/24h and both sides accelerating to roughly 400-520 casualties/hr. Oarbreaker is still very active (46 events/24h, latest event <1h old) with heavy back-and-forth at Posterus, Grisly Refuge, Integrum and Partisan Island, though Wardens hold an 8-1 edge. Clahstra is sharply escalating — casualty rates have more than doubled (~430-460/hr per side) with fresh events in the last 2 hours around Transept, East Narthex and Weephome, currently 6-2 Warden. Marban Hollow continues surging (~350/hr per side, events at Sanctum within hours, 5-3 Warden). Godcrofts stays a knife-fight (27 events/24h at Saegio/Argosa, latest event <30min old, 6-3 Warden). Speaking Woods is newly hot with the highest current casualty rates in the packet (~550-820/hr) after flips at Stem, now 7-1 Warden. Callahan's Passage shows massive sustained attrition (~10k-12k casualties/24h) but no events in ~9h. Quiet rear hexes remain static.
